filters.basis: PROVISIONAL: house values, no source; freezes shorter than freezedetect.d are not counted; the owner sets them on rendered samples

video.sharpness_basis: GUESS: floor at 0.02, rounded down from the lowest of 24 existing project samples (0.0241, measured 2026-11-22 in laplacian_var_over_gray_var_0_1); catches blank or badly blurred output only. Not a quality threshold; the owner sets it on approved samples.

no_melt.basis: PROVISIONAL: house proposals T9 and T10 of QUALITY_SPEC.md (plans_2026-11-21), no source; compensation of the camera move is not yet defined, so these numbers are not yet measured. The owner approves on rendered samples.

photo.sharpness_basis: GUESS: floor at 0.02, rounded down from the lowest of 24 existing project samples (0.0241, measured 2026-11-22 in laplacian_var_over_gray_var_0_1); catches blank or badly blurred output only. Not a quality threshold; the owner sets it on approved samples.
